description: Source code for a custom ColorPicker component supporting ARGB, including UI elements, color wheel, pipette, and dialog wrapper.

classes.name: ColorPicker
classes.description: Custom color picker component supporting ARGB, with UI elements, color wheel, pipette, and dialog.

classes.name: ColorWheel
classes.description: Graphical color wheel for selecting hue and saturation.

classes.name: ColorWheelImageProducer
classes.description: Generates the image for the color wheel.

classes.name: ColorPipette
classes.description: Color picker pipette tool for selecting colors from screen.

classes.name: ColorPickerDialog
classes.description: Dialog wrapper for the ColorPicker component.

classes.name: SlideComponent
classes.description: UI component for sliders (brightness, opacity) with mouse interaction.

methods.name: createColorField
methods.description: Creates a JTextField for color input (RGB/ARGB or Hex).

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the current color and updates UI.

methods.name: appendRecentColor
methods.description: Adds current color to recent colors list.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Schedules UI update based on text input.

methods.name: validateAndUpdatePreview
methods.description: Validates input and updates color preview.

methods.name: updatePreview
methods.description: Updates the color preview component and internal color state.

methods.name: fireColorChanged
methods.description: Notifies external listeners of color change.

methods.name: gatherRGB
methods.description: Reads RGB(A) values from text fields and creates Color.

methods.name: applyColorToHEX
methods.description: Updates hex text field based on current color.

methods.name: applyColorToRGB
methods.description: Updates RGB(A) text fields based on current color.

methods.name: applyColorToHSB
methods.description: Updates HSB text fields based on current color.

methods.name: applyColor
methods.description: Updates text fields based on current mode.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays the color picker dialog and returns selected color.

methods.name: buildTopPanel
methods.description: Constructs the top UI panel with color preview, pipette, and input fields.
